title: TREX Energy Commissions Lithium Battery Manufacturing Facility in Hyderabad
summary: Hyderabad-based energy storage solutions company TREX Energy has commissioned a lithium battery manufacturing facility at E-City in Hyderabad, Telangana.The company also plans to expand its manufacturing operations with a second facility in Madhya Pradesh. The state government has allotted four acres of land to TREX Energy for the proposed second phase of its manufacturing expansion.
